Name: New Skin for Pelican Town Municipal
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I love MidnightVoyager's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38698]Pelican Town Municipal[/url] mod, but since I play with Earthy, Wayback and Gwen's buildings, the municipal building didn't quite blend in. MidnightVoyager gave me permission for a reskin, so here it is, inspired by Eemie's Victorian series. The building is fully seasonal and features (what I think is) the town's flag! (It's supposed to be the same flag Lewis has anyway lol)

To install, simply download, then drag and drop to overwrite the original assets from PTM. ﻿

Enjoy!
